title: de.hubtask.work.item.purged.v1
description: An entry is gone for good. The one item event whose payload is not a snapshot, and it cannot be: the row it would describe no longer exists. What it carries is what a consumer needs in order to clean up after the entry - which one, of what type, where it was, and why it went - and no title and no notes: a purge that left the entry's content in an event stream would not be a deletion (ADR-0018, data-retention.md §5). Single-value enums stand in for `const`, and the bounds of a value are stated in its description rather than as keywords: the contract test validates against this file with the subset of JSON Schema the project implements, and a keyword it silently ignored would be a promise nobody checks. The wire format is a CloudEvent 1.0 in structured JSON (ADR-0007); the tenant, the actor and the causal chain travel as CloudEvents extension attributes, whose names are lower case without separators as the specification requires. Fields may be added; removing or reinterpreting one requires a .v2 delivered alongside .v1 for at least two minor releases (domain-model.md §4).

id.description: UUIDv7. Stable across delivery attempts, so a consumer deduplicates on it (at-least-once delivery).

source.description: The installation and the bounded context that produced the event.

subject.description: What the event is about, so that a consumer can filter without parsing the payload.

actorid.description: Absent when the system itself acts. No label: an event leaves the installation, and a name is personal data a subscriber does not need in order to react (ADR-0018).

onbehalfof.description: The principal an automation rule or an agent runs as.

correlationid.description: Everything that came out of one original action carries the same value. A root event is its own correlation.

causationid.description: The event that caused this one. Absent for an action a person took.

causationdepth.description: Distance from the original action. The rule engine stops at 5 and marks the run ABORTED_LOOP (automation.md §2).

data.description: What is left to say about an entry that no longer exists.

path.description: The materialised path the entry had. Everything under it went too, and the prefix is how that is expressed without an event per row (invariant I-W2).

reason.description: Whether a person asked for this - emptying a trash, purging one entry - or the tenant's retention policy did. An operator reading a cleanup log has to be able to tell those apart.
